summary.title: VimCasts.org
summary.one_liner: VimCasts.org offers free Vim screencasts and articles by Drew Neil, author of Practical Vim, for learning essential Vim skills.
takeaways: The site has 76 free Vim screencasts and 52 articles, browsable by category or publication date.
Neovim terminal buffers: yanking and pasting work between regular and terminal buffers, including Normal mode paste and a Terminal mode mapping.
Vim training classes (public or private) are offered for teams.
A Ruby-focused screencast series, made with thoughtbot, covers faster navigation in Ruby projects and a Ruby block text object (sold via thoughtbot).
Practical Vim (Pragmatic Bookshelf, 2012) is the recommended book; Modern Vim is now available in paperback.
summary.summary: VimCasts.org is a collection of free Vim screencasts and articles by Drew Neil, the author of Practical Vim. Content is browsable by category or by publication date, and the page highlights recent items such as a Neovim terminal-buffer paste tip. It also promotes paid extras: Vim training classes, the Practical Vim and Modern Vim books, and a Ruby-focused screencast series produced with thoughtbot. The page is mostly a catalogue with short descriptions rather than a full lesson.
